scripts/error_catalog_audit.py

Python · Tier B

Inventory production error identities and enforce explicit coverage in CI.

Usage

Run with --check to reject unresolved producers; --json writes the complete inventory.

Inputs

--root selects the checkout; explicit source-site classifications supply review rationale.

Side effects

Writes only the requested JSON report.

Cleanup

No runtime services, model requests or persistent state are opened.
